description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the SearchFace operation for face search
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸搜索SearchFace的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun facebody search-face --db-name default --image-url http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/facebody/SearchFace/SearchFace1.png --limit 2 --db-names test1,test2,test3 --quality-score-threshold 50.0 --max-face-num 5 --api-version 2019-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchFace

parameters.description_en:
The database name.

> Specify either **DbName** or **DbNames**. If both parameters are specified, **DbNames** takes priority over **DbName**.
parameters.description_zh:
数据库名称。

> **DbName**与**DbNames**二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，**DbNames**优先级高于**DbName**。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.description_en: The image URL. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~). The URL cannot exceed 1024 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。URL长度不超过1024个字符。
parameters.help_en: The image URL. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html. The URL cannot exceed 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。URL长度不超过1024个字符
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of face search results returned for a single face list. Valid values: 1 to 100.
parameters.description_zh: 单个人脸列表中搜索人脸结果数量限制，取值范围1~100。

parameters.help_zh: 单个人脸列表中搜索人脸结果数量限制，取值范围1~100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description_en:
The list of database names separated by commas (,). This parameter enables cross-database search and supports up to 10 databases.
> Specify either **DbName** or **DbNames**. If both parameters are specified, **DbNames** takes priority over **DbName**.
parameters.description_zh:
数据库名称列表，以英文逗号（,）分割，可以实现跨库查询，最大支持10个数据库。
> **DbName**与**DbNames**二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，**DbNames**优先级高于**DbName**。

parameters.description_en: The quality score threshold. The system performs quality analysis on the face image. If the quality score is lower than this threshold, the face image quality does not meet the requirements and the comparison fails. Valid values: 0.0 to 100.0. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that quality score evaluation is not performed.
parameters.description_zh: 质量分阈值。对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，得到的质量分小于该阈值则表示人脸图片质量不符合要求，比对失败。取值范围\[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做质量分判断逻辑。
parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. The system performs quality analysis on the face image. parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

parameters.description_en: The number of faces in the input image to search and compare. This parameter controls the number of face sample lists. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 5.
parameters.description_zh: 对输入图像中多少个人脸进行检索比对，控制人脸样本列表个数，取值范围1~10，默认为5。
